definitions.name: Thinking Stone
definitions.summary: From 10th level: four 1st-level and three 2nd-level wizard spells (1 action, bonus action or reaction; no concentration), each cast once per long rest without a slot to store it in a nonmagical object (it goes to your inventory, to use or give away). DC 8 + proficiency, attack + proficiency.
text: Your ingenuity and artistic nature surpass the limits of an ordinary mind. As the first stones to speak in Asleza declared, "There is nothing that stone cannot create." To create, and to be created.

Choose four 1st-level spells and three 2nd-level spells from the Sophist spell list. Each spell must have a casting time of 1 action, 1 bonus action, or 1 reaction, and must not require concentration. These spells are not considered prepared for you, and they do not require a spellcasting ability. The saving throw DC for these spells equals 8 + your proficiency bonus, and your proficiency bonus serves as your spell attack modifier for them.

Using any artisan's tool with which you are proficient or have expertise, you can store these spells inside nonmagical objects. To do so, you must cast the spells normally (spells with a casting time of 1 reaction do not need to be triggered for this purpose). You can store each of these spells in a nonmagical object only once per long rest. However, you do not expend a spell slot when casting them for this purpose.

A creature that can understand you and has an Intelligence score of 7 or higher can also activate the spell stored in an object, provided you spend 1 minute explaining how to do so and the creature has the object in its possession when it wishes to activate the spell.

definitions.name: Human Above All
definitions.summary: From 10th level: one feat of your choice whose prerequisites you meet.
text: Perhaps these were the words most misunderstood by the human race. Yet their meaning is not diminished by their misinterpretation.

Transcendence, adaptability, and the ability to surpass your own limits are the very essence of humanity. Where others are constrained by their nature, you discover new paths and become something greater than you once were.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet all the prerequisites.

definitions.name: Adama
definitions.summary: From 10th level, proficiency bonus times per long rest: with advantage or disadvantage, add both d20s together instead of keeping one; a total of exactly 20 counts as a natural 20. Decide before rolling; nothing changes either die.
text: Your heritage allows you to understand both what separates elves from other creatures and what can bring them together. You belong wholly to neither of these worlds; instead, you can bridge the divide between them.
Most importantly, as someone once said for the first time: "I am not two halves, but two wholes."

When you make a roll with advantage or disadvantage, you can add the results of the dice together instead of choosing one of them. A total of 20 counts as a natural 20 on an attack roll or a death saving throw.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. You must decide to use it before rolling the dice. Nothing can influence or alter either of these two dice rolls, positively or negatively.

definitions.name: Unbridled Seasons
definitions.summary: From 10th level: your season's gifts (below; Charisma is the spellcasting ability for their spells), and Fey Step also as a reaction when you take damage, with a 60-foot range.
text: To you, the seasons are not merely the passage of time, but living forces that change, clash, and are reborn. Within you dwell the exuberance and vitality of Titanspring, the ferocity and brilliance of Heammer, the decay and tranquility of Slumberfall, and the silent threat and certainty of Nocter.
Depending on the season you represent, you gain the following benefits:

Titanspring. You can cast Aura of Vitality without requiring concentration, once per long rest. Additionally, you can use the Fighter's Action Surge feature one additional time beyond the number of times you can normally use it.

Heammer. You can cast Beacon of Hope without requiring concentration, once per long rest. In addition, all your weapon attacks deal an extra 2 magical fire or radiant damage (your choice). The damage rolls of your spells that deal fire or radiant damage also increase by the same amount.

Slumberfall. You can cast Short Rest with a duration of 1 combat round instead of 10 minutes, once per long rest. Additionally, when you score a critical hit against a creature, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn.

Nocter. You can cast Sleet Storm without requiring concentration, once per long rest. When you cast the spell in this way, you are unaffected by the spell and its heavily obscured area. However, if you are not within the spell's area of effect at the start of one of your turns, the spell ends. In addition, all your weapon attacks deal an extra 4 magical cold or necrotic damage (your choice). The damage rolls of your spells that deal cold or necrotic damage also increase by the same amount.
Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this feature.
Finally, you can also use your Fey Step as a reaction when you take damage, and its range permanently increases to 60 feet.

definitions.name: Thinking Stone object
definitions.summary: A nonmagical object holding a spell a Rock Gnome stored in it (Thinking Stone). Whoever holds it and was shown how (1 minute; Intelligence 7 or higher) can release the spell; its DC is 8 + the gnome's proficiency bonus and its attack bonus is that proficiency bonus. Used up once used.
